grammar.summary: 本课学习将来完成时与被动语态的组合。

points.title: 将来完成时 will have done
points.explanation: 到将来某点为止将已完成：By the end of this year, they will have finished the work. by + 时间 是标志。

examples.en: The Olympic Games will be held in our country.

points.title: 将来进行/完成的被动
points.explanation: will be held（将来被动）；will have been completed（将来完成被动）复合结构。

examples.en: The games will be held in four years' time.
